responseMessageContents.text:
No problem — you’re on the right screen, but Render’s mobile view makes the service selector hard to find.

Use this direct link in your browser:

**https://dashboard.render.com/background/srv-d9i15fg4n6ts73bn00j0/env**

Then tap **Environment** → **Add Environment Variable** and enter:

- **Key:** `AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY`
- **Value:** your Vercel key (`vck_...`)

Tap **Save Changes**. Render will restart the worker automatically.

If that link opens an access error or a different service, send a screenshot of the page title only (please keep all variable values hidden), and I’ll guide the next tap.
